This secondary compound also targets Phosphodiesterase 6C, suggesting a potential mechanism of action involving the transport of cationic amino acids and their subsequent impact on enzyme activity. The evidence suggests that the interaction may involve a shared pathway or mechanism, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
